SELECT a.cd_grop_cd AS cd_group, /* 코드그룹 */ a.cmmn_cd AS cd, /* 코드 */ a.cmmn_cd_nm AS cd_nm, /* 코드명 */ a.use_yn, /* 사용여부 */ a.sort_seq AS sort_order, /* 정렬순서 */ TO_CHAR(a.sys_reg_dttm, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS') AS reg_dt /* 등록일시 */ FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd a /* 코드 */ WHERE 1=1 AND a.cd_grop_cd = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD' AND a.lcal_cd = 'ko' AND a.use_yn = 'Y'
AND a.cmmn_cd_nm LIKE '%' || #{searchKeyword} || '%'
ORDER BY a.sort_seq, a.cmmn_cd
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cdm_own.cmmn_cd ( cd_grop_cd, cmmn_cd, cmmn_cd_nm, lcal_cd, sort_seq, use_yn, sys_reg_dttm, sys_reg_usr_id ) VALUES ( 'FAQ_CLSF_CD', COALESCE((SELECT MAX(CAST(cmmn_cd AS INTEGER))+1 +1 FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd WHERE cd_grop_cd = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD'),1), #{cdNm}, 'ko', COALESCE( (SELECT MAX(CAST(sort_seq AS INTEGER))+1 +1 FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd WHERE cd_grop_cd = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD'), 0 ) + 1, 'Y', NOW(), #{regId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE cdm_own.cmmn_cd SET cmmn_cd_nm = #{cdNm}, sort_seq = #{sortOrder}, sys_chg_dttm = NOW(), sys_chg_usr_id = #{updId} WHERE cd_grop_cd = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD' AND cmmn_cd = #{cd} AND lcal_cd = 'ko'
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM cdm_own.cmmn_cd WHERE cd_grop_cd = 'FAQ_CLSF_CD' AND cmmn_cd = #{cd} AND lcal_cd = 'ko'
